notes: Daytona 1000, Quota 1000 and early California injection applications. The previous KWP2000/1A 80 definition was unsupported and has been removed. Vendored IAW Scan 2 source proves that the automotive IAW-04K.P8 uses direct 7680-baud echoed one-byte requests, ISO bytes 0x30-0x35 and part-number bytes 0x36-0x3F. No Moto Guzzi P8 capture or primary definition ties that register map to motorcycle firmware, so no capability is exposed and physical use is blocked. The automotive layout remains only as provenance metadata.

session.physical_blocked_reason: Automotive IAW-04K evidence defines the legacy direct protocol, but no Moto Guzzi P8 primary definition or capture was recovered.

memory.write_blocked_reason: No validated in-circuit memory-access sequence is available for the Moto Guzzi P8. Maps normally live in a socketed EPROM; use an EPROM programmer and preserve the original chip.

sources: IAW Scan 2 source a5995eab86e82be60386e99b2eecc9c14810ec85: ECU/ecu.cs and ECU/iaw04k.cs (automotive IAW-04K.P8; application to Moto Guzzi remains unconfirmed)
